report.root_cause: Chunk (1,0) in world/region/r.0.0.mca was corrupt (zlib decompress error: incorrect header check), last saved 05:50:30. The server failed to read it and logged "chunk data will be lost". The server also went down and restarted by itself early in the shift, before I did anything. I didn't establish whether the corruption caused that restart.
report.actions: Watched the server and saw it go down and come back on its own. Found the chunk read errors in the logs and confirmed with mca inspect that chunk (1,0) was the only corrupt chunk in r.0.0.mca. Declared the incident. Confirmed the backup copy (backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca) had a good chunk (1,0). Stopped the server, copied only that chunk from the backup into the live region file, and started the server again. Afterwards, mca inspect showed 0 corrupt chunks, no new errors appeared in the log, TPS was 20 and both players were online.
report.residual_risk: The restored chunk (1,0) is from the backup of about 05:50:04. Any changes players made in that chunk between then and the corruption are lost. The backup is a single day old, and I didn't find what caused the corruption, so it could recur. The two players were disconnected during my restart. The earlier self-restart and whether it was related were not investigated.
